name: Start-Stop-Continue
description: A simple, general-purpose format: the team says what it wants to start doing, stop doing and keep doing. A good default when you are unsure which format to pick.

columns.name: Start
columns.prompt: What should we begin doing that we are not doing yet?

columns.name: Stop
columns.prompt: What should we stop doing because it does not help us?

columns.name: Continue
columns.prompt: What is working well and should we keep doing?

mood.neutral: Three clear columns work for almost any team.

goal.reflect-period: It looks back and turns it into changes.
goal.reflect-project: It turns what happened into clear next steps.

checkInQuestion: In one word: how are you arriving today?
facilitationTips: Explain the three columns in one sentence each before the writing starts.
Ask everyone to write at least one note per column so quiet people get a voice.
In the discussion, begin with the Stop column: it often holds the most useful topics.
